contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Silver coin. Denarius of an indeterminate early Roman ruler, probably female, with the appearance of gilding on one side [the reverse], and a relict trace of gilding on the obverse. Possibly Severan issue of Reece period 10 or 11, issue of 193-237. Obverse description: Bust coiffed and draped right with right arm outstretched holding ?vessel. Reverse description: Draped figure seated left, gilded…
